invocation: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 bazel --batch --ignore_all_rc_files --output_user_root=<private> COMMAND in a fresh copy of ws/ (MODULE.bazel module(name='gcv'), bazel_dep platforms 1.0.0 from bcr.bazel.build, bazel_dep ext with local_path_override ext/)

outputs.all_ok.txt: build //pkg:all_ok, then the contents of bazel-bin/pkg/all_ok.txt
outputs.errors.txt: build //err:T for T in no_cmd bad_var not_unique no_exec: the first 'ERROR: ' line of each, the workspace path as <WS>

covers: genrule command selection (GenRuleBase.determineCommandTypeAndAttribute: cmd_bash over cmd, a select()ed cmd_bash, an explicit empty cmd_bash, cmd_bat/cmd_ps ignored off Windows, the missing-command error), Make variables (SRCS, <, @, RULEDIR, @D, COMPILATION_MODE, BINDIR, GENDIR, TARGET_CPU), an expansion error named after cmd_bash, `message` (the progress message), `local`, `output_to_bindir`, `stamp` 1/-1/0 with and without --stamp (the workspace status inputs), `heuristic_label_expansion` (and its not-unique error), `exec_compatible_with` (and the no-execution-platform error), empty aspect_hints/compatible_with, $(@D)/$(RULEDIR) of an external repository's root package (zlib's copy_public_headers shape); every ActionKey
normalized: '# Configuration: <BuildOptions checksum>' lines (native ConfigIds); the configuration hash in the toolchain-resolution error
